title: [27/12/2022] Factors affecting work performance of two age groups
prompt: The bar chart below shows the results of a survey conducted by a personnel department at a major company. The survey was carried out on two groups of workers: those aged from 18-30 and those aged 45-60, and shows factors affecting their work performance. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The given bar chart gives information on the different factors that influence work performance among two age groups, namely 18-30 and 45-60.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, it is clear that the two demographics share similar opinions on the majority of factors; however, the younger group highly regards personal development, a relaxed work environment, job security, and promotion prospects, noticeably more so than the older group.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the chart in more detail, the top concern for younger workers is having the chance to develop themselves, as 90% of them believe so, versus only around 40% of older workers agreeing. Promotion prospects and a relaxed work environment are the next two most important factors for workers under 30, being mentioned by 80% of them. By contrast, only half of the workers over 45 cite the former as a factor, and only a third of them bring up the latter.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: With regard to the remaining factors, money is the top concern for older workers, and fourth for younger ones, with roughly 70% of all workers surveyed mentioning it. 60% of workers in both groups also claim that team spirit is important, double the figure for the work environment among older respondents. Having job satisfaction, a competent boss, or respect from co-workers is cited by around 45% of all workers, with the older group placing a greater emphasis on the aforementioned factors, except for job satisfaction. Finally, 40% of younger employees want job security, which is double the figure for the older group.
